title: SwiftLoop: Selective Refinement for Adaptive Implicit Reasoning in Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.31481v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers advance implicit chain-of-thought reasoning through recurrent latent refinement. However, existing looped reasoners typically employ fixed-depth recurrence, updating all latent positions at every iteration and incurring redundancy when further refinement is unnecessary. We introduce \textsc{SwiftLoop}, an inference-time framework for selective recurrent refinement through position-wise freezing, enabling adaptive computation allocation across both recurrent depth and active width. SwiftLoop learns lightweight freezing policies through hindsight-guided supervision derived from two complementary criteria: K/V reusability at the internal representation level and functional impact at the output level. At inference time, these policies guide adaptive freezing based on observed hidden states. translated_title: SwiftLoop：面向循环 Transformer 自适应隐式推理的选择性精炼方法
translated_abstract: 循环 Transformer 通过对潜在表示的反复精炼来推进隐式思维链推理。然而，现有的循环推理器通常采用固定深度的循环，在每次迭代中更新所有潜在位置，当无需进一步精炼时会造成冗余计算。我们提出 SwiftLoop，这是一个推理时框架，通过位置级别的冻结实现选择性循环精炼，从而在循环深度和活跃宽度两个维度上实现自适应的计算分配。SwiftLoop 通过由两个互补准则导出的后见之明引导监督来学习轻量级冻结策略：内部表示层面的 K/V 可复用性以及输出层面的功能性影响。在推理阶段，这些策略基于观察到的隐藏状态引导自适应冻结。大量实验表明，SwiftLoop 相比固定循环推理实现了更优的精度-计算权衡。
tldr: SwiftLoop 提出在推理时通过位置级冻结策略对循环 Transformer 进行选择性自适应精炼，同时优化循环深度与活跃宽度两个维度的计算分配，以更低的计算成本获得更优的推理精度。
